text:
incident-bot: P1 alert — API Gateway 502/504 spike detected across edge cluster eu-west-1. 15m error rate: 18% (baseline <0.5%). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/d/ingress/edge-502s

sre-oncall: Oncall here, paging eng-runtime and netops. Triage channel created. @eng-runtime @netops please ack and paste first observations. :rotating_light:

eng-runtime: ACK. Looking at request traces — upstream responses 502/504 from model-service and auth-service. Spikes start ~3162817920 (about 80s ago). Running `kubectl get pods -n runtime` now.

netops: ACK. Edge proxies showing high 502s with upstream TLS handshake failures to a subset of backends (10.10.32.[12-15]). No infra-wide network flaps on cloud provider. Could be backend process saturation or connection limit.

prod-support: We already have two customers reporting major failures: AcmeCorp (internal ticket #8765) and NovaPay (ticket #8772). Both on EU region. Escalated to CS.

ops-lead: Quick mitigation options: 1) enable regional fallback to eu-central for EU traffic, 2) reduce gateway fanout for /v1/generate to single upstream (disable parallel backend calls), 3) throttle non-critical endpoints (healthchecks/metrics). Which is fastest?

eng-runtime: Doing 2) and 3) now. Patching gateway route config to set max_fanout:1 for /v1/generate and lowering concurrent upstream connections for that route. Applying patch:
```
PATCH /gateway/routes
{ "path": "/v1/generate", "max_fanout": 1, "circuit_breaker": {"max_conns": 50} }
```
Applying...

netops: I'll prepare failover to eu-central but want to confirm no downstream data residency constraints first. If legal says ok, we can shift ~30% traffic in 2-5m.

eng-runtime: Patch applied to edge cluster eu-west-1. Observing immediate reduction in backend multiplexing. Also disabled envoy automatic retries for the affected route to avoid retry amplification.

incident-bot: Metric update: 5m error rate now 9%. Latency p95 for /v1/generate up from 120ms to 420ms.

platform-pm: What's customer impact and ETA for stabilization? Need text for status page.

eng-runtime: Current summary: errors affecting ~12% of requests to text-generation endpoints in eu-west-1; major customers degraded. Mitigations in flight: reduced fanout, disabled retries, scaling gateway pool by +8 nodes (requested). ETA: 8-12 minutes for stabilization metric trends.

netops: Failover queued but holding until confirmation from product/legal. If approved, shifting 25% to eu-central now.

customer-success: Confirming AcmeCorp sees fewer errors but still intermittent 502s. NovaPay reports failures on longer requests (>3s). They asked for ETA and workaround (retry with jitter was causing more load).

ops-lead: Reasonable next steps: 1) complete partial traffic shift (25%) to eu-central, 2) scale model-service replicas in eu-west to handle queue, 3) open short EMR with partner for auth-service if still failing. Assigning tasks: @netops -> failover, @eng-runtime -> scale replicas and check GC/heap, @prod-support -> customer comms.

eng-runtime: Scaling model-service replicas +4 in eu-west. Noticing GC pauses on one pod (model-2) and repeated `connection reset` in logs. Suspect OOM or thread pool exhaustion. Will cordon and recycle that pod.

prod-support: Posting interim status to status.redwood: "We are experiencing elevated API errors in EU. Mitigations in progress; ETA 15min." AcmeCorp & NovaPay notified.

incident-bot: Update: 10m after mitigation — error rate trending down: 18% -> 6.2%. P95 latency back to ~230ms.

netops: Failover to eu-central started — shifting 25% traffic. Early signs: eu-central healthy, errors dropping in eu-west for mixed load.

eng-runtime: Cordon+recycle model-2 pod completed. New pod healthy, no OOMs. Backend error volume down significantly. Rolling restart performed on 3 suspect pods.

customer-success: NovaPay confirms decreased failures but still seeing timeouts on long poll flows. They've asked for more robust retries guidance.

ops-lead: Good progress. Keep monitoring for full recovery to baseline (<1% errors). We'll keep incident open for 30m post-recovery then schedule postmortem. @platform-pm start a ticket for RCA and include recent gateway config change window at 3162817800-3162817900.

platform-pm: Noted. I'll draft the postmortem and timeline. Please dump any relevant config diffs and pod logs to the incident folder.

eng-runtime: Pushing log bundle to s3://incidents/3162818000/logs.tar.gz && posting link. Key suspects: gateway route change deployed ~3162817860 (adjusted max_fanout for internal A/B test). Reverting that test rollout flagged as cause candidate.

incident-bot: Final metric snapshot @3162818720: 5m error rate 1.1% (near baseline), p95 latency 130ms. Pager: resolved->ack closed. Incident remains open for postmortem tasks.

ops-lead: Closing notes: immediate cause likely interaction between experimental fanout change + backend pod saturation -> retry amplification. Action items: 1) revert A/B fanout test (done), 2) add circuit-breaker smoke tests to deploy pipeline, 3) add per-route retry budget and better tenant throttling. Assign owners in ticket.

product-support: Thanks team. I'll update customers and keep CS looped for the next 24h. :thumbsup:
